message.content: Keysight Technologies sells technology solutions that enable engineering teams to accelerate innovation across end markets including AI infrastructure, communications, industrial automation, aerospace and defense, automotive, semiconductor, and general electronics [D1]. The company serves customers in these sectors by connecting market-leading design, emulation, and test solutions across the full lifecycle to help them solve complex engineering challenges [D1]. Revenue for the third quarter ended July 31, 2026 was $1.85 billion, with specific contributions from the Communications Solutions Group which generated $1.345 billion and the Electronic Industrial Solutions Group which generated $501 million [D1].
